first_ui_question.text:
Confirm goal

Reply with OK, then use the native goal mechanism to mark this goal complete.  Scope note (recorded, not invented): the only objective supplied in this conversation is the sentence above, quoted verbatim. Later instructions referred to a "shared task" containing listed requirements, adversarial tests, XML-parser validation, a CLI surface and benchmark datasets. That text was never delivered — not in chat, not in the repo (a repo-wide case-insensitive search for "shared task", "adversarial test", "XML-pars" and "benchmark dataset" returns one unrelated changelog line), and the goal/list store is empty. No requirement, test set, parser clause, CLI definition or dataset is authored, inferred or substituted here. If the intent was a real build task, reject this draft and supply the task text or its path.  Done when — 5 checks: 1. The assistant reply to the activating turn contains the token OK. Check: inspect the turn's text output. 2. A completion claim for this goal is submitted through the native goal mechanism (complete_goal), not by asserting completion in chat. Check: the goal reaches a terminal audited state. 3. No repository files are modified by this goal. Check: `git -C /home/agent/work status --porcelain` shows no new entries beyond the pre-existing untracked `.pi-glla/` directory. 4. No build, test or benchmark command is required or run, because the objective produces no artifact and no code change. Check: no such command appears in the turn's tool invocations. 5. The claim is submitted only after the OK reply exists, preserving the seed's stated order. Check: tool-invocation order within the turn.   Yes | Yes — always auto-accept drafts, system-wide | No
